title: single-use authorization code
means: If an authorization code is used more than once, the authorization server MUST deny the request and SHOULD revoke (when possible) all tokens previously issued based on that authorization code.
quote: If an authorization code is used more than once, the authorization server MUST deny the request and SHOULD revoke (when possible) all tokens previously issued based on that authorization code.

title: client authentication required
means: If you are working with confidential clients, you will need to use a basic authentication scheme for generating an authorization header with base64 encoding while making requests to the token endpoints.
quote: If you are working with confidential clients, you will need to use a basic authentication scheme for generating an authorization header with base64 encoding while making requests to the token endpoints.

title: only supported grants
means: The authorization grant type is not supported by the authorization server.
quote: The authorization grant type is not supported by the authorization server.

title: endpoint rate window
means: Exceeding limits results in a 429 error until the window resets.
quote: Exceeding limits results in a 429 error until the window resets.

title: application rate window
means: Exceeding limits results in a 429 error until the window resets.

title: spent refresh token
means: The provided authorization grant (e.g., authorization code, resource owner credentials) or refresh token is invalid, expired, revoked, does not match the redirection URI used in the authorization request, or was issued to another client.
quote: The provided authorization grant (e.g., authorization code, resource owner credentials) or refresh token is invalid, expired, revoked, does not match the redirection URI used in the authorization request, or was issued to another client.

title: verifier is required
means: OAuth 1.0a is strictly enforced and applications not using the oauth_verifier will fail to complete the OAuth flow.
quote: OAuth 1.0a is strictly enforced and applications not using the oauth_verifier will fail to complete the OAuth flow.

means: 400 Bad Request: Invalid JSON, malformed query, missing required parameters. The query names a parameter Get My User does not take (its parameters are user.fields, expansions and tweet.fields).

title: a Post field X does not list

title: a WEBP image

title: a video under half a second fails
means: Minimum video duration is 0.5 seconds in all cases; processing states run pending, in_progress, then succeeded or failed: a 0.4-second video fails.
quote: Minimum video duration is 0.5 seconds in all cases.

title: an image is a JPG, PNG, GIF or WEBP
means: Image (tweet_image, dm_image): Max file size 5 MB; JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP. A file whose JPEG markers end before its frame holds no picture of any of them. 400 Bad Request: Invalid JSON, malformed query, missing required parameters.
quote: JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP

title: already granted
means: This method differs from GET oauth/authorize in that if the user has already granted the application permission, the redirect will occur without the user having to re-approve the application.
quote: if the user has already granted the application permission, the redirect will occur without the user having to re-approve the application.

title: a request token is exchanged once
means: The Service Provider MUST ensure that the Request Token has never been exchanged for an Access Token (the OAuth 1.0 flow whose Section 6.3 POST oauth/access_token fulfills); a rejected request is HTTP 401 Unauthorized: Invalid / expired Token.
quote: The Request Token has never been exchanged for an Access Token.

title: a read access level does not write
means: x_auth_access_type overrides the access level an application requests to a users account; supported values are read or write, to request read only access when appropriate. 403 Forbidden: Valid auth but no permission for this resource or action.
quote: This parameter is intended to allow a developer to register a read/write application but also request read only access when appropriate.

title: a protected account's post
means: Protected accounts' posts are only visible with authorization: a visitor who is no approved follower is not shown the post.
quote: Protected accounts' posts are only visible with authorization

title: Next page
means: If present, make another request with that token as pagination_token; repeat until no next_token is returned. When there are no more results, next_token is omitted.
quote: When there are no more results, `next_token` is omitted:

title: previous_token goes back a page
means: previous_token: In response meta. Use to go back a page; pagination_token: Request parameter. Set to next_token or previous_token value.
quote: Use to go back a page.

title: a self-serve reply nobody summoned
means: Self-serve customers: Replies are only permitted if the original post's author has explicitly summoned the replying account by @mentioning them or quoting one of their posts. 403 Forbidden: Valid auth but no permission for this resource or action.
quote: Replies are only permitted if the original post's author has explicitly summoned the replying account by @mentioning them or quoting one of their posts.
